lines.text: Some say there is no resurrection of the dead, but if Christ is not raised, preaching and faith are worthless.
If the dead are not raised, we are false witnesses about God, and you are still in your sins.
Christ has been raised, and as in Moses all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.
Christ hands the kingdom to God the Father, and the last enemy He destroys is sin.
We endanger ourselves every hour, and I face death every day.
